title: Deploy Chattic.us-web from main through CodePipeline, not GitHub Actions
description: Chattic.us-web is private, and GitHub Actions on private AnthusAI repos fails on billing, so the marketing site is deployed by hand from an SSO login. Ryan's policy: no human or agent AWS login in the update path. Add a ChatticusMarketingPipeline CDK stack in Chattic.us-web (modeled on Cyclotron-web's CyclotronMarketingPipeline) in the account that holds ChatticusMarketing: a CodeStar connection to GitHub, a verify CodeBuild stage running the ci.yml checks, and a deploy stage running deploy-chatticus-marketing.sh with CHATTICUS_MARKETING_INCLUDE_APEX=1, then the live copy smoke. Remove the Actions deploy workflow it replaces. Done when a push to main deploys chattic.us with no manual step.
